provenance: Project-authored parameter examples for supervised policy reproduction; not a public real-world benchmark
task: Classify whether a declared RSA size meets the configured 2048-bit minimum; does not establish complete RSA security
limitations: Labels explicitly authored against a simple size policy; learning this boundary is not a novel vulnerability detector
Boundary examples 2047 and 2048 are intentionally taught in train; test measures reproduction at different declared values
Declared sizes are parameter inputs, not proof a provider will accept or generate a key of that size
Do not combine these metrics with independent public-code benchmark metrics
